prompt: Which numbered color swatch at the bottom best matches the underlying map color at the CENTER of the circular marker? Match the map color, not the marker outline or the gray grid lines. Return only one digit from 1 to 6. Do not read numerical map values or report the grid cell.

conditions.blue: Exact RGB of a preselected non-target blue-dominant swatch; varies by point

design: Same neutral prompt for both colors; same points, choices, positions, center pixels and model. Alternate condition order by point.
primary: All 32 reused test points, paired selection rate of the preselected blue distractor under red vs blue outlines; accuracy secondary; missing/invalid incorrect. Development separate; exploratory follow-up.
